={{ `Reddedildi

parameters.query: SELECT rule_name, weight_config, version FROM scoring_rules WHERE is_active = true;

additionalFields.lastName: ={{ (() => { const parts = ($('Calculate Lead Score').first().json.normalized.contact_name || '').trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean); return parts.length > 1 ? parts.slice(1).join(' ') : ''; })() }}

parameters.subject: ={{ "🔥 Yüksek Skorlu Lead: " + ($('Calculate Lead Score').first().json.normalized.company_name || $('Calculate Lead Score').first().json.normalized.domain) + " (Skor: " + $('Calculate Lead Score').first().json.lead_score.total_score + ")" }}
